content_html_sanitized:
Posted May 15, 2003
Analysis by Richard Cowan

Canada is a relatively new country politically, and it is confronted with the problem of having a separate identity, beyond formal sovereignty, to distinguish itself from its hyperpower neighbor.

Most Canadians really like Americans and American culture and yet they don't want to be Americans. This ambivalence was heightened in the recent debate over whether to support the Iraqi war, but it is being replayed again in the confusion notice that I did not say debate about its cannabis policies.
See
 Canada's New Decriminalization Bill To Be Delayed After Justice Minister's Trip to Washington, and Health Minister's Trip to the Marvelous World Of Marijuana Make-Believe. John Walters In Drag?

Justice Minister Martin Cauchon made a serious political blunder when he went to Washington to tell John Ashcroft about the proposed decriminalization bill even before he told his own Liberal Party Parliamentary caucus about it. However, that trip did underline the fact that the Canadians are aware of the importance of the issue to DEAland, but I think that most of them, including Cauchon, still don't really get it.

Some of the Canadian prohibitionists use What will the neighbors think? as a reason not to do what they don't want to do anyway regardless of what the neighbors think. Others are so ignorant of the fact that Canada is not a major source of cannabis in the DEAland market, that they think that Washington has a legitimate concern.

Others, like Cauchon, think that the current administration is just a little crazy, but can be appeased by playing with penalties on growers, and thereby addressing the supply-side that might be of relevance to them.

Ashcroft is a nutcase and Walters is an ideologue, filled with hatred like his patron, Bet-A-Million Bennett, but the prohibitionist fear of deviation from the party line is entirely rational. Ashcroft and Walters know the numbers. The data are on their own websites.
See
 Three Separate Canadian Stories May 13, 2003. You Connect The Dots. Steve Tuck's Hearings; Canadian Justice Minister Grovels Toward Gomorrah, DC That Is. And A Subtle Twist In The Party Line.
and
 As Canada Moves Toward Some Form Of Decriminalization, Canadian Narks and Walters Escalate Lying. The New Math. Canada Replaces Mexico As Leading Supplier of Cannabis. And If You Believe That

All else being equal, softening the law against possession would have no impact on the supply available for export. Indeed, if it did cause an increase in demand, as the prohibitionist claim, then it would actually reduce the supply available to export. That would be even truer, if the proposed increase in penalties for growing had any impact, beyond increasing the role of organized crime.
See
 Organized Crime In The Marijuana Trade.
Why More " Law Enforcement " is Counterproductive.
An Excellent Halifax Editorial Says, " Marijuana laws encourage crime. "

Many of the more cynical observers here think that the Chretien government really wants the Supreme Court to do the heavy lifting, so that there is no political expense to the Liberal party. However, that would still leave them with a problem with the neighbors.

I call the United States of America, my country, DEAland, because judging by the actions of this and the previous Administrations prohibitionism is the state ideology, and the suppression of cannabis is its very soul.

In Orwell's 1984 perpetual war was the way of justifying the police state. Orwell's immediate model was Stalin's Soviet Union, but there is nothing new about power grabs being justified by wars and spies and terrorist threats.
See
The 50th Anniversary of The Publishing Of Orwell's 1984
Analysis By Richard Cowan

Drugs make a great enemy, but it is cannabis that is the key, both economically and politically.
See
 " Mom, Dad, What are Drugs? "

Cannabis arrests make up roughly half of all drug arrests in DEAland (and even more in Canada and the UK.) They are also the source of the best booty in the forfeiture rackets. Cannabis users have money that can be tapped by the rehab racketeers. Consequently, cannabis prohibition has been called the meat and potatoes of the drug war.

The demonization of cannabis is also the heart of the prohibitionist ideology. It is to prohibitionism what anti-Semitism is to fascism, or what homophobia is to the Christian right.

The song says, everybody needs somebody to love, but in a police state everybody needs somebody to hate. That's us.

It is ironic that a gay member of the Canadian Parliament is currently pushing a bill to make lying about gays a hate-crime, but lying about cannabis dominates government policies. Gays in Canada are not subject to arrest, but cannabis users are. Gays are sometimes subject to cowardly attacks, but medical cannabis users are left to suffer, while the supposed Health Minister listens to the narks instead of the sick and dying and disabled.
See
 Health Canada's Office of Cannabis Medical Access' Stakeholder Advisory Committee Includes Physicians for A Smoke Free Canada - Not The Compassion Societies. But It Will Let Them Talk For An Hour
and
 The Ottawa Citizen Tells It Like It Is:
A Great Editorial On Drug War Summit,
Medical Marijuana and DEAland Narco-Imperialism

As a gay man, I can say that cannabiphobia is a much bigger problem for Canadian society than homophobia.
See
 Is The War On Cannabis A Cult? Taking Cannabiphobia To New Depths Of Absurdity. A Method to Their Madness?

Without cannabis arrests, the power of the drug war to control millions of peaceful citizens would be lost. Without cannabiphobia, the ideology of the drug war would lose its power to justify its violence against millions of peaceful citizens.
See
 Is the War On Drugs A Just War. "? Should It Be Easier To Justify Violence Against A Foreign Dictatorship Than Against Peaceful Citizens Of One's Own Country?

Moreover, there is a saying in Washington that probably originated with Watergate: It's not the crime. It's the cover-up. They couldn't abandon the war on cannabis, even if they wanted to, and some of the more rational would like to. How the hell could they explain away decades of reefer madness and millions of arrests, and the suppression of medical cannabis and even hemp?
See
 The Police Fraud. Someone Is Lying. Marking The 30th Anniversary Of An Article in National Review. What if Don Quixote Was Right? Analysis by Richard Cowan

So here they are. The nice people just to the North, the ones who look like us and talk like us, and send us some of our best comedians, want to deviate from the party line on cannabis. That puts everything in danger.

And what if their worst nightmare happens? What if the Canadian Supreme court tosses out the whole mess around the first of the year?
See
 Canadian Supreme Court Hearings Could Make History, But They Are Only Good For A Joke In DEAland Media. Filed Under Oddly Enough. Dude, Is This Journalism?

Now is the time to begin the preemptive warnings and make the biggest possible stink about essentially meaningless changes in the laws.

What would happen if Canada were to legalize cannabis, and became Holland next door, and the sky does not fall, and hard drug use goes down, and violence goes down?
See
 The Dutch Demonstrate Common Sense, and the Canadians Even the Police Seem Ready to Learn 3 Articles

This would be a mortal threat to the entire police mechanism that is the farm team for the Republican Party and the control system for the drug war complex.

Right now there is a bit of concern over the failure to find the weapons of mass destruction that were the original justification for the Iraqi war. But that is nothing compared with the political problems that would arise from the failure to discover a national disaster in Canada after cannabis legalization.

That is why they have to lie about the Dutch experience, but Canada is too close to lie about.
See
 UN Nark's Speech To Swedish Prohibitionists May Cause Permanent Brain Damage. Illogic, Ignorance and Lying, Especially About the Dutch, Of Course.

If the Canadian politicians and people just knew the power that they have to change the world by restoring freedom to the American people and the global victims of the drug war, I think that they would rise to the occasion.
See
 DEAland Collaborates With Colombia Cartels To Bring Cocaine And Violence To The Caribbean. Island Growers Caught In The Middle.

It really would not take much courage. The prohibitionist fear the truth, because they fear freedom.
See
 Calling All Quacks: The Therapeutic Police State and the Politicization of Medicine. Doctors Cannot Study The Violence of Cannabis Prohibition. Because They Are The Disease, Not The Cure.
and
 The Prohibitionist Police State Versus The People. Analysis By Richard Cowan

Canada needs to have a national debate on cannabis prohibition in order to resolve its own problems, but in doing so they could resolve the world's problems with the global police mechanism that threatens freedom as nothing else can in the age of the prohibitionist hyperpower.

The only problem is that first they must inform themselves to free themselves.
See
 Canada Exports A Little Reefer to DEAland. Imports A Lot of Reefer Madness. A Bad Balance of Trade. Canadian Taxpayers Are Being Lied to At Their Own Expense, But It May Also Cost Them Their Freedom.
and
 Police Interference in the Canadian Electoral Process. The Royal Canadian Marijuana Police Disinformation Campaign for Marijuana Prohibition. Analysis by Richard Cowan.
and
 The Next Prime Minister of Canada Talks War On Us. Looming Prohibitionist Counterattack in Canada Proves Need for International Debate On Cannabis Prohibition.

Also please see MarijuanaNews Still Needs Your Help. An Appeal From Richard Cowan.
